description: Full detail for a single Ukraine ProZorro tender by id (via the keyless OpenProcurement public API). Returns tenderID, title, description, status, procurementMethod + procurementMethodType (raw OCDS fields — broad method vs ProZorro's specific type, e.g. aboveThresholdUA/aboveThresholdEU), tender_value (the ORIGINAL ASKING PRICE — not money spent), the buyer/procuring entity (name, EDR identifier, region, contact), tender period (start/end), enquiry period, number of bids, line items (description, CPV classification, quantity, unit, relatedLot), `lots` (id/title/status/value, when the tender is lotted), and the OCDS award/contract stage: `award` (operative award: status, date, value, winning supplier, lotID, bid_id — null if none) plus the full `awards` history (each with the FULL `suppliers[]` array — name + identifier scheme/id — alongside the single-supplier `supplier` field kept for backward compatibility), and `contract` (signed contract value/date). An `interpretation` line states plainly whether the tender_value was ever actually spent. Pass `raw:true` to also get the complete, unshaped upstream OCDS tender object under `raw`, for any field not shaped above. Text is largely Ukrainian. Accepts the internal 32-char tender id OR a human tenderID ("UA-2026-09-20-000012-a") — for a tenderID this now tries to resolve the internal id by scanning the most-recently-modified feed records first (cheap, usually one call for anything modified in the last few hours) and returns FULL detail when that succeeds; it falls back to the search index's summary (detail_available:false, no awards) only when the tender wasn't modified recently enough to be found that way.

id.description: Tender id — the internal 32-hex id (e.g. "156db6e773ba4b6e925d00f9ad3b13f4") from prozorro_recent_tenders always returns full detail. A human tenderID ("UA-2026-09-20-000012-a") from prozorro_search_tenders is also accepted; full detail depends on whether it can be resolved (see tool description) — detail_available in the response says which case you got.

raw.description: Include the complete, unshaped upstream OCDS tender JSON under `raw`. Only applies when full detail is available (detail_available:true). Default false — the raw object can be large (documents, full bids, etc).

name: prozorro_get_tender
title: Prozorro Get Tender
